Arraste o corpo para mover ou um termina: Drag the body to move or a terminal to stretch. The other end stays fixed; Delete removes the selection.
Clique na grade para adicionar um resist: Click the grid to add a 1 kΩ resistor.
Clique na grade para adicionar uma fonte: Click the grid to add an ideal 5 V source. Port a = +; port b = −.
Clique em um terminal ou junção, na grad: Click a terminal or junction, the grid for bends, and another terminal to finish. Escape cancels.
Clique na grade para criar uma junção. C: Click the grid to create a junction. Connect wires explicitly to it.
Clique em um terminal ou junção para def: Click a terminal or junction to set the 0 V reference.
SI units; notation such as 1e3 is accepted.
a (+) → b (−). Corrente positiva de a pa: a (+) → b (−). Positive current flows from a to b.
Tensão Va − Vb; corrente positiva de a p: Voltage Va − Vb; positive current flows from a to b.
Defina o terra e clique em Simular. Resu: Set ground and click Simulate. Editing invalidates results.
Correntes negativas indicam sentido opos: Negative currents indicate the opposite direction to a → b. Individual ideal wire currents are not calculated.
Junções explícitas · cruzamentos não con: Explicit junctions · crossings do not connect
Os fios ficam no lugar, com junções nas: Wires stay in place, with junctions at the old endpoints.
Arrastar um terminal também mantém suas: Dragging a terminal also keeps its connections.
Arrastar um terminal desconecta apenas a: Dragging a terminal disconnects only the moved endpoint.
Selecione um componente para editar seu: Select a component to edit its value.
Modelo ideal, linear e em regime permane: Ideal, linear, steady-state model. Data is held in memory only: reloading the page resets the circuit.
As duas portas de cada símbolo são a e b: The two ports of each symbol are a and b, on the left and right before rotation. To branch, place a junction and end each wire there. Overlapping endpoints do not connect automatically.
Escape cancela a ferramenta. Delete excl: Escape cancels the tool. Delete removes the selection. Choose Ground and click a point to mark 0 V.
Editor de circuito. Use as ferramentas e: Circuit editor. Use the tools and click the grid; wires connect terminals or explicit junctions.
Choose a component and click the grid.
selectedWire: Wire selected. Use Delete to remove it.
selectedJunction: Junction selected. Use Delete to remove it.
title: Reactive Circuit · DC Simulator
description: Browser-based DC circuit editor and simulator with modified nodal analysis.
diagnostic_reference: A connection references a missing terminal or junction.
diagnostic_value: Enter positive resistance and finite voltage for the indicated components.
diagnostic_ground: Mark a terminal or junction connected to a component as ground (0 V).
diagnostic_floating: A subcircuit is not connected to ground.
diagnostic_inconsistent: Incompatible constraints: check for shorted sources or conflicting voltages.
diagnostic_singular: The circuit has no unique solution: check redundant sources and floating nodes.
diagnostic_numerical: A numerically reliable solution could not be obtained.
